card.name: Mass units before a per-volume slash
card.fires_on: The unit word mg or ng right after a number, when a slash or the word per follows to make a rate such as mg/mL or mg/kg. It is common in concentrations and dose-per-weight statements.

modes.description: mg or ng after a number in a concentration, followed by /mL or per mL.

modes.description: mg after a number or heading in a dose per kg or per hour expression.
modes.example: using oral doses of 2.5<< mg>>/kg/day, 10 mg/kg

card.writes: It seems to push toward a following slash and per-unit term, such as per, rather than other continuations.
card.plain: It lights up on mg or ng in expressions like mg/mL, just before the slash and the 'per' part.
